custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

NTRCA-Head.question:
১) Reading is one of the most valuable habits a person can develop. It not only improves knowledge but also enhances imagination and critical thinking. Through books, people can explore different cultures, ideas, and perspectives. Reading regularly also helps in building vocabulary and improving communication skills. In today’s digital age, many people spend more time on social media than reading books. However, developing a reading habit can greatly benefit students in their academic and personal lives. A good book can inspire, educate, and entertain at the same time, making reading an essential part of life.

Questions 01–03 are based on the following passage. Read the passage carefully and answer the questions.
What does reading improve?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Knowledge and imagination.

• Reading is one of the most valuable habits a person can develop. It not only improves knowledge but also enhances imagination and critical thinking.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২) Why is reading important for students?
NTRCA-Head.option4: It benefits academic and personal life
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - It benefits academic and personal life.

• Reading regularly also helps in building vocabulary and improving communication skills. In today’s digital age, many people spend more time on social media than reading books. However, developing a reading habit can greatly benefit students in their academic and personal lives.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩) What is the main idea of the passage?
NTRCA-Head.option4: Reading is only for passing the time
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Reading is a valuable habit.

• The passage mainly focuses on the importance of reading as a valuable habit. It explains how reading improves knowledge, enhances imagination and critical thinking, and helps develop vocabulary and communication skills. It also highlights that reading benefits students in both academic and personal life. All these points support the central idea that reading is essential and highly beneficial.

NTRCA-Head.question:
৪) He had a go at fixing the machine.
What part of speech is “go”?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The Correct answer is - Noun.

- Article এবং Preposition এ মধ্যে কোন শব্দ থাকলে সেটি সাধারণত Noun হিসেবে ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- Sentence টিতে "go" শব্দটি Noun. কারণ এর আগে Article (a) ও Preposition (at) আছে।
- এটি Verb (had) এর Object হিসেবে ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।  

• Go (Noun):
- English meaning: The act or manner of going.
- Bangla meaning: গমন; ব্যাপার; গতি; কর্মশক্তি; সফল অভিযান।

• Example sentence:
- He had a go at painting the wall.
- Let me have a go at driving the car.

Source: Accessible Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Merriam Webster Dictionary, Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৫) Pluck me a flower. (make it passive)
NTRCA-Head.option1: Let a flower be plucked by me.
NTRCA-Head.option2: Let a flower be plucked to me.
NTRCA-Head.option3: Let a flower be plucked with me.
NTRCA-Head.option4: Let a flower be plucked for me.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• শুধুমাত্র মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু করা Imperative sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
 - Let দিয়ে Passive voice এর বাক্যটি শুরু হবে।
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- be বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active voice এর Verb এরপর Passive voice এ by ছাড়া অন্য preposition বসে। যেমন: to, at, on, with, for ইত্যাদি।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active voice: Pluck me a flower.
• Passive voice: Let a flower be plucked for me.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৬) Choose the correct sentence.
NTRCA-Head.option1: You, he and me went to the school.
NTRCA-Head.option2: You, him and I went to the school.
NTRCA-Head.option3: He, you and I went to the school.
NTRCA-Head.option4: You, he and I went to the school.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Correct Answer: You, he and I went to the school.

• I, You and He হলো Personal Pronoun এর উদাহরণ।
- First person, Second person, Third person- এর Pronoun বা Noun সব যদি একই বাক্যেতে ব্যবহার থাকে তাহলে প্রথমে 2nd person, পরে 3rd person এবং অবশেষে 1st person বসে।
- অর্থাৎ সংক্ষেপে (231- order).

- কিন্তু দোষ স্বীকারের ব্যাপার হলে তখন ব্যবহার করতে হবে (123- order).
- Example: I, you and he are to blame.

• উল্লিখিত বাকি অপশনগুলো,
• (ক) ও (খ) Sentence এ Verb এর আগে সব সময় Person এর Subjective form ব্যবহার করা হয়। তাই Me এর জায়গায় I এবং Him এর জায়গায় he ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- Correct Answer: You, he and I went to the school.

• (গ) Sentence টিতে First person, Second person, Third person- এর Pronoun বা Noun সব যদি একই বাক্যেতে ব্যবহার থাকে তাহলে প্রথমে 2nd person, পরে 3rd person এবং অবশেষে 1st person বসবে।
- Correct Answer: You, he and I went to the school.

Source:
- A Passage To The English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৭) Which of the following words can form a correct and meaningful word when the prefix ‘mis-’ is added?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The prefix 'mis' can be added to - print.

• Print → Misprint (Noun, verb):
- English Meaning: to print (something, such as text) incorrectly.
- Bangla Meaning: মুদ্রণে/ছাপাতে ভুল করা; ভুল ছাপানো।

• Some words with the prefix 'Mis':
- Misunderstand,
- Mislead,
- Mistrust,
- Misprint,
- Misfire,
- Misinterpret,
- Misconduct,
- Mischievous,
- Mismatch, etc.

• উল্লিখিত বাকি অপশনগুলো,
ক) legal - Illegal.

খ) hurt - Unhurt.

ঘ) check - Recheck.

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy, Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৮) Which suffix can be added to the verb “arrive” to make it a noun?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• By adding the suffix -al to the verb "arrive," we form the noun arrival.

• Arrival [arrive+al] (Noun):
- English Meaning: the act of arriving at a place.
- Bangla Meaning: আগমন।

• Suffix:
- Suffix (=after) fix = that which is fixed after a word.
- একটি word-এর পরে নূতন শব্দ গঠনের জন্য suffix বসে।
- Prefix গুলির আলাদা অর্থ থাকলেও- able, fold, full, less প্রভৃতি কয়েকটি suffix ছাড়া suffix গুলির নিজস্ব কোন অর্থ নেই।
- এগুলি যে শব্দের সঙ্গে যুক্ত হয়, তার অর্থকে প্রভাবিত অর্থাৎ প্রসারিত বা সঙ্কুচিত করে।
- এই ভাবে Suffix যোগে নুতন শব্দ গঠিত হয়।
- এই শব্দ Noun, Adjective, Verb বা Adverb হতে পারে।

• Common suffixes for Noun:
- Happiness (ness).
- Pleasure (ure).
- Agreement (ment).

NTRCA-Head.question: ৯) In linguistics, semantics refers to -
NTRCA-Head.option2: the study of human speech sounds
NTRCA-Head.option3: the study of meaning in language
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• In linguistics, semantics refers to - the study of meaning in language.
- Semantics হলো ভাষাবিজ্ঞানের একটি শাখা যা ভাষার অর্থ নিয়ে আলোচনা করে।

• Semantics:
- English meaning: The study of meanings in a language.
- Bangla meaninng: ভাষার অর্থঘটিত কিংবা শব্দার্থবিজ্ঞানঘটিত; শাব্দার্থিক; বাগর্থিক; আর্থ; শব্দার্থতাত্ত্বিক। 

• উল্লিখিত বাকি অপশনগুলো,
- the study of sentence formation – Syntax.
- the study of human speech sounds – Phonetics/Phonology.
- the study of word formation – Morphology.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১০) The word "Anthropology" is related to -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The word "Anthropology" is related to - The study of mankind.

• Anthropology (Noun):
- English meaning: The study of human societies and cultures and their development.
- Bangla meaning: নরবিজ্ঞান; নরবিদ্যা; নৃতত্ত্ব।

• উল্লিখিত বাকি অপশনগুলো,
• Pathology:
- English meaning: The study of diseases.
- Bangla meaning: রোগবিদ্যা; রোগবিজ্ঞান।

• Mineralogy:
- English meaning: The scientific study of minerals.
- Bangla meaning: খনিজবিষয়ক বিজ্ঞান; খনিজবিজ্ঞান।

• Evolutionary biology: The study of evolution.

Source: Oxford Dictionary & Bangla Academy Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question:
১১) In recent years, countries around the world have increased their focus on renewable energy. Solar, wind, and hydroelectric power are becoming more popular as alternatives to fossil fuels. Governments are encouraging the use of clean energy to reduce pollution and combat climate change. Many nations are setting ambitious targets to achieve carbon neutrality within the next few decades. Although the transition to renewable energy requires significant investment, it offers long-term benefits such as cleaner air and sustainable development. This global shift is crucial for protecting the environment and ensuring a better future.

Questions 11–13 are based on the following passage. Read the passage carefully and answer the questions.
What type of energy is being promoted?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Renewable energy.

• The passage clearly states that countries are focusing more on renewable energy. It mentions:
“Solar, wind, and hydroelectric power are becoming more popular as alternatives to fossil fuels.”

• These are all types of renewable energy, and the passage also says that governments are encouraging their use to reduce pollution and fight climate change.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১২) Why are governments supporting renewable energy?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - To combat climate change.

• Governments are encouraging the use of clean energy to reduce pollution and combat climate change. Many nations are setting ambitious targets to achieve carbon neutrality within the next few decades.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১৩) What is a benefit of renewable energy?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Cleaner air.

• The transition to renewable energy requires significant investment, it offers long-term benefits such as cleaner air and sustainable development. This global shift is crucial for protecting the environment and ensuring a better future.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১৪) Choose the correct spelling.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The correct spelling is 'Administration' (Noun).

• Administration:
- English meaning: The activities that are done in order to plan, organize and run a business, school or other institution.
- Bangla meaning: প্রশাসন; পরিচালনা; ব্যবস্থাপনা।

• Example sentence: The new school administration introduced stricter rules for students.
- Bangla meaning: নতুন স্কুলের প্রশাসন ছাত্রদের জন্য কঠোর নিয়ম চালু করেছে।

Source: Accessible Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Merriam & Webster Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question:
১৫) A bomb exploded somewhere near.
Here, the word "Near" is a/ an -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• A bomb exploded somewhere near. Here, the word "Near" is a/ an - Adverb.

- এখানে "near" শব্দটি "exploded" এর স্থান নির্দেশ করছে, অর্থাৎ বোমাটি কোথায় বিস্ফোরিত হয়েছে।
- এটি verb "exploded"-এর সাথে সম্পর্কিত এবং অবস্থান বা স্থান নির্দেশ করে, তাই এটি একটি adverb.

• Near (Adverb):
- English Meaning: at a short distance away.
- Bangla Meaning: নিকটবর্তী; কাছে।

 • Adverb: 
- যে Word কোনো Verb কেমন করে, কোথায়, কখন, কীভাবে কার্য সম্পন্ন করে, অথবা কোনো Adjective ও অন্য Adverb -এর দোষ-গুণ নির্দেশ করে, তাকে Adverb বলে।

Source: Oxford Dictionary, Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১৬) _____ German language is spoken in Germany and Austria.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• ভাষার নামের পূর্বে The বসে না।
- Example: English is an international language.

• কিন্তু ভাষার পর Language শব্দটি থাকলে উক্ত ভাষার পূর্বে The ব্যবহার করা হয়।

• Correct Answer: The German language is spoken in Germany and Austria.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১৭) The antonym of the word 'Abridge' is -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Abridge (Verb):
- English Meaning: Shorten (a piece of writing) without losing the sense.
- Bangla Meaning: (বিশেষ করে কোনো পুস্তকের শব্দসংখ্যা কমিয়ে) সংক্ষিপ্ত করা।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Supplement - উৎকর্ষ বা সম্পূর্ণতার জন্য যা যোগ করা হয়; পৃথক সংযোজন।

খ) Heckle - জনসভায় বক্তাকে বারবার থামিয়ে দিয়ে তাকে নানা কূটপ্রশ্নে জর্জরিত করা; খোঁচাখুঁচি করা; জ্বালাতন/অতিষ্ঠ/উত্ত্যক্ত করা।

গ) Decrease - কমা; হ্রাস করা বা পাওয়া।

ঘ) Averse - বিমুখ; পরাঙ্মুখ; বিরোধী; অনীহ; অনিচ্ছু।

• সুতরাং, অপশনের অর্থ বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The antonym of the word 'Abridge' is - Supplement.

 Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy, Merriam-Webster Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১৮) The meaning of the idiom "Yeoman's work" is -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Yeoman's work/ service: (Noun)
- English meaning: Very good, hard, and valuable work that someone does especially to support a cause, to help a team, etc.
- Bangla meaning: বিনা স্বার্থে ভালো কাজ করা। 

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Altruistic action - পরার্থসম্মতভাবে কাজ করা,

খ) Stone's throw - অতি নিকটে,

গ) Tooth and nail - তীব্রভাবে,

ঘ) Lame excuse - বাজে ওজর।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The meaning of the idiom "Yeoman's work" is - Altruistic action.

Source:
- Merriam & Webster Dictionary,
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

NTRCA-Head.question: ১৯) Who is driving the car? (make it passive)
NTRCA-Head.option1: Whom is the car being driven by?
NTRCA-Head.option2: By whom is the car being driven?
NTRCA-Head.option3: By whom is being the car driven?
NTRCA-Head.option4: Who is the car being driven?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এর রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Who এর পরিবর্তে By whom দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হবে।
- tense ও person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- অনেক সময় be/ being/ been বসাতে হয়।
- মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Question mark (?) হয়।

• Active voice: Who is driving the car?
• Passive voice: By whom is the car being driven?

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২০) Which one of the following is a plural number?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Cattle is the Plural Number.

• Number:
- কোন ব্যক্তি, বস্তু বা প্রাণীর সংখ্যাকে Number বলে।
- Number দুই প্রকার। যথা:
01. Singular Number
02. Plural Number

• কিছু শব্দ আছে যেগুলো সব সময় Singular হিসেবে ব্যবহার করা হয়। যেমন:
- Information,
- Furniture,
- Scenery,
- Poetry,
- News, etc.

• আবার কিছু কিছু শব্দ আছে যা সব সময় Plural হিসেবে ব্যবহার করা হয়। যেমন:
- Cattle,
- People,
- Police,
- Folk, 
- Vermin, etc.

Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. Das.

NTRCA-Head.question:
২১) Technology has transformed the way education is delivered. With the help of the internet, students can access a vast amount of information anytime and anywhere. Online classes, educational apps, and digital tools have made learning more interactive and engaging. Teachers can now use multimedia resources to explain complex topics more effectively. However, excessive use of technology can also lead to distractions and reduced concentration. Therefore, it is important to use technology wisely. When used properly, technology can greatly enhance the learning experience and make education more accessible to everyone.

Questions 21–23 are based on the following passage. Read the passage carefully and answer the questions.
How has technology changed education?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Made learning more accessible.

• Technology has changed education by making learning more accessible and interactive. Students can access information anytime and anywhere using online tools and resources.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২২) What is a disadvantage of technology?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Distraction.

• The passage on technology in education mentions that while technology has many benefits, such as making learning interactive, providing access to information, and improving teaching methods— it also has disadvantages. Specifically, it states:

"However, excessive use of technology can also lead to distractions and reduced concentration."

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৩) What is the main idea of the passage?
NTRCA-Head.option1: Technology improves education if used wisely
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Technology improves education if used wisely.

• It is important to use technology wisely. When used properly, technology can greatly enhance the learning experience and make education more accessible to everyone.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৪) Titu went to ___ school because she had ___ important lecture.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Article এর নিয়ম অনুসারে,
- School, college, market, bed, hospital, prison, mosque, temple, church, court of ইত্যাদি মূখ্য উদ্দেশ্যে (যেটা যেটার জন্য নির্মিত) ব্যবহৃত হলে কোন Article বসে না।
- যেমন:
- I go to school.
- He went to market.

• একই ভাবে,
- She went to the college where her brother studied.
- কিন্তু স্থানগুলো অন্য উদ্দেশ্যে ব্যবহৃত হলে এদের আগে Article বসে।

• দ্বিতীয় ক্ষেত্রে শব্দ (Important) টি Vowel এর উচ্চারণ দিয়ে শুরু হওয়ায় এর পূর্বে Article an বসবে।

• Correct Answer: Titu went to college because she had an important lecture.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৫) We ought to obey our teacher. (make it passive)
NTRCA-Head.option1: Our teacher ought to obeyed by us.
NTRCA-Head.option2: Our teacher ought to be obeied by us.
NTRCA-Head.option3: Our teacher are ought to be obeyed by us.
NTRCA-Head.option4: Our teacher ought to be obeyed by us.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Active voice এ Modal Auxiliary Verb থাকলে তা Passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Modal Auxiliary verb গুলো হলো: Can, Could, May, Might, Will, Would, Shall, Should, Ought to, Used to, Must ইত্যাদি।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Active voice এর Modal verb টি বসে।
- be বসে।
- প্রদত্ত মুল verb এর past participle বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active Voice: We ought to obey our teacher.
• Passive voice: Our teacher ought to be obeyed by us.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৬) Karim said to him, "Let us forget the matter." (make it indirect)
NTRCA-Head.option1: Karim proposed to him that they should forget the matter.
NTRCA-Head.option2: Karim said to him that they should forget the matter.
NTRCA-Head.option3: Karim proposed to him that they have forgotten the matter.
NTRCA-Head.option4: Karim requested to him that they should forget the matter.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Let যুক্ত sentence এর indirect করার নিয়ম:
- Let এরপর us থাকলে indirect করার সময় reporting verb টি পরিবর্তিত হয়ে propose / suggest হয়। 
- Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- they/ we + should বসে।
- Reported Speech এর মূল verb থাকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।
- Reporting verb এর Subject third person হলে that এরপরে they বসে, এবং Reporting verb এর subject first person হলে that এরপরে we বসে।

• Direct speech: Karim said to him, "Let us forget the matter." 
• Indirect speech: Karim proposed to him that they should forget the matter.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৭) The headmaster and secretary ______ present at yesterday's meeting.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• And দ্বারা যুক্ত sentence এ যদি subject একই ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুকে বুঝায় তবে তাদের verb ও pronoun singular হয়।

• Correct answer: The headmaster and secretary was present at yesterday's meeting.
- এখানে headmaster এবং secretary দ্বারা একই ব্যক্তিকে বুঝানো হয়েছে। আর sentence টিতে yesterday উল্লেখ্য থাকায় sentence টি past tense হবে।
- তাই, সঠিক উত্তর হবে - was.

• আবার, And দ্বারা যুক্ত sentence এ যদি subject একই ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুকে না বুঝিয়ে ভিন্ন দুটি ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুকে বুঝায় তখন তাদের verb ও pronoun plural হয়। 
- Sub দুটি ব্যক্তি এটি বুঝার সহজ উপায় হলো Subject বা Noun এর পূর্বে Article আছে কিনা তা লক্ষ্য রাখা।
- Noun দুটি ভিন্ন হলে noun দুটির আগে the থাকবে।
- Example: The Headmaster and the Secretary are present in the meeting.

• And দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েও যদি noun-গুলি একই অর্থ প্রকাশ করে তখন verb টি singular হয়ে থাকে। 
Example: Bread and butter is my favourite breakfast.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৮) Which of the following nouns denotes a masculine gender?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Stallion.

• Stallion: (Masculine gender)
- English meaning: An adult male horse.
- Bangla meaning: পূর্ণবয়স্ক ঘোড়া (পুরুষ)। 

- Stallion এর Feminine gender হলো: Mare.
- English meaning: A female horse.
- Bangla meaning: ঘোটকী।

• Other Options,
• Mare:
- Gender: Feminine.
- Meaning: A female horse (ঘোটকী)।
- Masculine: Stallion.

• Cow:
- Gender: Feminine.
- Meaning: A female cattle (গাভী)।
- Masculine: Bull.

• Ewe:
- Gender: Feminine
- Meaning: A female sheep (ভেড়ী)।
- Masculine: Ram.

Source:
- A Passage To The English Language, S. M. Zakir Hussain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ২৯) She invested money with an eye to ______ profit.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• সাধারণত to এর পর Verb এর base form হলেও কিছু কিছু শব্দগুচ্ছ সমূহের পর verb+ing হয়।

• শব্দগুচ্ছ সমূহ হলো:
- With a view to,
- With an eye to,
- Accustomed to,
- Adhere to,
- Adverse to,
- Addicted to,
- Committed to,
- Confess to,
- Devoted to,
- Look forward to,
- Conducive to,
- Addicted to,
- Be used to,
- Get used to

• Correct Sentence: She invested money with an eye to earning profit.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩০) Excessive noise can be detrimental ____ children’s learning.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Detrimental (Adjective):
- English meaning: Causing or capable of causing harm.
- Bangla meaning: ক্ষতিকর।

• ক্ষতিকর অর্থে Detrimental এরপর preposition হিসেবে To বসে।

• Complete Sentence: Excessive noise can be detrimental to children’s learning.

• Example Sentence:
01. Laziness is detrimental to success.
02. Excessive screen time can be detrimental to children's eyesight.
03. Pollution is highly detrimental to the environment.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question:
৩১) Artificial Intelligence (AI) has rapidly become one of the most discussed technologies in recent years. From chatbots to self-driving cars, AI is transforming industries and changing how people work and live. Many companies are investing heavily in AI to improve efficiency and reduce human effort. However, this rapid growth also raises concerns about job loss and ethical issues. Experts believe that while AI will replace some jobs, it will also create new opportunities. To adapt to this change, people need to develop new skills and embrace lifelong learning.

Questions 31–33 are based on the following passage. Read the passage carefully and answer the questions.
What is AI mainly doing today?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Transforming industries.

• From chatbots to self-driving cars, AI is transforming industries and changing how people work and live. Many companies are investing heavily in AI to improve efficiency and reduce human effort.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩২) What concern is mentioned in the passage?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Job loss.

• Many companies are investing heavily in AI to improve efficiency and reduce human effort. However, this rapid growth also raises concerns about job loss and ethical issues.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৩) What should people do to adapt?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Develop new skills.

• Experts believe that while AI will replace some jobs, it will also create new opportunities. To adapt to this change, people need to develop new skills and embrace lifelong learning.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৪) She refused _____ (help) him with the assignment.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• কিছু Verb আছে যেগুলোর পর যদি আরেকটি Verb ব্যবহার করতে হয়, তাহলে infinitive (to+verb) ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- Verb এর সাথে Verb+ing ব্যবহার করা যাবে না।

• Verb গুলো হচ্ছে:
- agree,
- want,
- arrange,
- decide,
- demand,
- require,
- forget,
- propose,
- manage,
- refuse,
- ask, etc.

• Correct Answer: She refused to help him with the assignment.

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৫) She will have completed the project _____ Monday.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• ভবিষ্যৎকালের ব্যাপক সময়ের পূর্বে in বসে এবং নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের জন্য by অথবা before বসে।

• অতীতের নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে since অথবা from এবং ব্যাপক সময়ের পূর্বে for বসে।

• Correct answer: She will have completed the project before Monday.
- প্রদত্ত Sentence টি Future Tense এ আছে এবং Monday উল্লেখ করার কারণে সময়টি নির্দিষ্ট বুঝিয়েছে।
- তাই, এখানে in ব্যবহার না হয়ে before ব্যবহার হয়েছে।

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৬) He is not good ____ physics.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• শুন্যস্থানে সঠিক উত্তর হবে - at.
- Correct answer: He is not good at physics.

• Good at অর্থ হলো দক্ষ।
- দক্ষতা/ অদক্ষতা বুঝাতে শব্দের সাথে at ব্যবহৃত হয়। যেমন- good at, bad at etc.
- কোনো কিছুতে দক্ষ বোঝাতে সাধারণত Good at বসে ।

• Example sentence:
- He is bad/ good at cricket. [a bad/ good player]
- I am not bad at tennis.
- He is good at English.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৭) (a) <u>Either the teacher</u> (b) <u>or the students</u> (c) <u>has forgotten their homework</u>. (d) No error.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - c.

• Either --- or, Neither --- nor দ্বারা Singular Subject যুক্ত হলে Verb Singular হয়।
- Example: Either he or his brother is guilty.

• Either --- or, Neither --- nor দ্বারা যুক্ত Subject যদি ভিন্ন Person এর হয় তবে Verb টি শেষ Subject অনুযায়ী নিবে।
- Example: Neither he nor his friends are present in the class.

• Structure:
- [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + singular noun + singular verb.
- [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + plural noun + plural verb.

- উল্লিখিত বাক্যে Subject ভিন্ন ভিন্ন Person এবং verb এখানে Singular হিসেবে has বসেছে।
- কিন্তু শেষ subject (the students) plural হওয়ায় (verb) has না হয়ে have (plural verb) হবে।

• Correct Sentence: Either the teacher or the students have forgotten their homework.

Source:
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৮) They'd completed the project on time, _______?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• Confusing Contraction sentence এর tag question করার নিয়ম:
- যদি subject এরপর 'd থাকে অর্থাৎ, verb টি base form এ আসে, তাহলে এটিকে modal auxiliary হিসেবে would ধরতে হবে।
- Example: If I were a rich man, I'd establish a hospital, wouldn't I?

- তবে 'd এরপরের verb টি যদি past participle form এ থাকে তাহলে তাকে past perfect tense এর had হিসেবে ধরতে হবে।
- Example: I'd reached there in time, hadn't I?

• Correct answer: They'd completed the project on time, hadn’t they?

Source:
- Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৩৯) Tokyo is one of the most crowded cities in the world. (make it comparative)
NTRCA-Head.option1: Tokyo is more crowded than the most other cities in the world.
NTRCA-Head.option2: Tokyo is more crowded than most other cities in the world.
NTRCA-Head.option3: Tokyo is more crowded most other cities in the world.
NTRCA-Head.option4: Most other cities in the world are more crowded than Tokyo.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর sub এবং verb বসে।
- One of the উঠে যায়।
- Superlative Degree এর Comparative form বসে।
- than most other বসে।
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে। 

• Superlative Degree: Tokyo is one of the most crowded cities in the world. 
• Comparative Degree: Tokyo is more crowded than most other cities in the world. 

Source:
- A Passage To The English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.
- Live MCQ English Wizard by Saleh Ahmed.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪০) Though he has a lot of money, he is not happy. (make it Simple)
NTRCA-Head.option1: In spite of his being a lot of money, he is not happy.
NTRCA-Head.option2: Despite of his having a lot of money, he is not happy.
NTRCA-Head.option3: In spite of his having a lot of money, he is not happy.
NTRCA-Head.option4: Because of his having a lot of money, he is not happy.
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Though/ Although Clause- এ has/ have/ had থাকলে সে ক্ষেত্রে Complex Sentence কে Simple Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Though/ Although এর পরিবর্তে Despite/ In Spite of বসে।
- Subject অনুসারে এর Possessive form বসে।
- has/ have/ had এর পরিবর্তে having বসে।
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসবে।

• Complex Sentence: Though he has a lot of money, he is not happy.
• Simple Sentence: In spite of his having a lot of money, he is not happy. 

• Note:
- Despite এর সাথে কখনো of ব্যবহৃত হয় না। তাই এখানে Despite of ভুল।

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

NTRCA-Head.question:
৪১) Climate change is not only an environmental issue but also a growing cause of human migration. Rising sea levels, droughts, and extreme weather events are forcing people to leave their homes in search of safer places. This phenomenon, known as climate migration, is increasing rapidly. However, many countries are unprepared to handle large numbers of displaced people. This creates social, economic, and political challenges. Addressing climate migration requires global cooperation, long-term planning, and support for vulnerable communities to adapt to changing environmental conditions.

Questions 41–43 are based on the following passage. Read the passage carefully and answer the questions.
What is "climate migration"?
NTRCA-Head.option1: Moving to a new country for vacation
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Movement due to environmental changes.

• The passage defines climate migration as the movement of people forced to leave their homes because of environmental changes such as:
- Rising sea levels,
- Droughts,
- Extreme weather events.

• The passage states: "This phenomenon, known as climate migration, is increasing rapidly."

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪২) The tone of the passage is -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The tone of the passage is - Concerned.

• The passage discusses climate migration and its serious consequences:
- Rising sea levels, droughts, and extreme weather force people to leave their homes.
- Many countries are unprepared to handle displaced populations.
- It creates social, economic, and political challenges.

• The language and focus show worry and urgency about the problem, which indicates a concerned tone.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৩) What is suggested as a solution?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Global cooperation and planning.

• Many countries are unprepared to handle large numbers of displaced people. This creates social, economic, and political challenges. Addressing climate migration requires global cooperation, long-term planning, and support for vulnerable communities to adapt to changing environmental conditions.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৪) A "memorandum" (memo) is generally used for -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• A "memorandum" (memo) is generally used for - Internal communication within an organization.

• Letter দুই প্রকার। যথা -
i) Informal Letter : যা ব্যক্তিগতভাবে আত্মীয়স্বজন বা বন্ধুবান্ধবের কাছে পাঠানো হয়।
ii) Formal Letter: Official বা Business সংক্রান্ত চিঠিপত্র। যেমন - Application, Memorandum ইত্যাদি।

- সুতরাং, "Memorandum" is one kind of - Formal Letter.

• Memorandum:
1. a short note written to help one remember something or remind one to do something/ a record of events or observations, esp. one for future use. 
2. an informal written communication, as from one department to another in an office.
3. In diplomacy - a summary or outline of a subject under discussion, reasons for or against some action, etc.
4. In Business - a statement, made by the consignor, of the goods and terms of a consignment sent with the privilege of return.
5. Law - a short written statement of the terms of an agreement, contract, or transaction.

• তাছাড়া একটি formal letter এর প্রধান অংশ হলো ছয়টি। যথা:  
1. Heading - প্রেরকের নাম, ঠিকানা ইত্যাদি।
2. Salutation - যেমন Sir, Dear X.
3. Body.
4. Complimentary close or, subscription. যেমন: remain, Sir/ Yours faithfully,
5. Signature - স্বাক্ষর।
6. Address or, superscription.

Source: Collins Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৫) Which of the following writing forms requires unity and cohesion in its content as essential qualities?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The required answer is - Paragraph.

• Paragraph শব্দের অর্থ হলো অনুচ্ছেদ।
- যে কোনো Paragraph এর মধ্যে দুটি উপাদান বর্তমান থাকা অত্যন্ত প্রয়োজন।
- এগুলো হলো- Cohesion এবং coherence.
- Coherence হচ্ছে paragraph এর বিভিন্ন অংশের সমন্বয়।

• Coherence:
- English meaning: Systematic or logical connection or consistency/ the situation when the parts of something fit together in a natural or reasonable way.
- Bangla meaning: একত্র আসঞ্জনশীল/ সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ; প্রাঞ্জল।
• লেখায় Coherence (সঙ্গতি) তৈরি করার জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হল যে সমস্ত ধারণাগুলি একে অপরকে সঠিকভাবে এবং যৌক্তিকভাবে অনুসরণ করে।
- এর মাধ্যমে পাঠক সহজেই লেখার বিষয়বস্তু বুঝতে পারে এবং লেখাটি প্রাঞ্জল ও সুসংগত মনে হয়।
- এটি পাঠকের জন্য লেখাটিকে পরিষ্কার এবং বুঝতে সহজ করে তোলে।

• Cohesion:
- একত্র এঁটে থাকার অবস্থা বা প্রবণতা; আসঞ্জন; যে শক্তিবলে অণুসমূহ পরস্পর আসঞ্জিত বা দৃঢ়ভাবে একত্র লেগে থাকে।
- A paragraph has good cohesion when each sentence is clearly linked to the next through language.
- It maintains the smooth connection between words, phrases, and sentences.

• Cohesion (Unity) & Coherence (Logical Sequence of thoughts) are essential in paragraph writing.

• তাছাড়া Paragraph এ সাধারণত তিনটি অংশ থাকে।
01. Topic Sentence: 
- একটি Paragraph এর প্রধান idea বা theme যে বাক্যের দ্বারা প্রকাশিত হয় তাকে topic sentence বলে।
- Topic Sentence সাধারণত কোনো Paragraph এর শুরুতে লেখা হয়। 
- Topic Sentence এ অবশ্যই একটি Controlling Idea থাকবে যা Paragraph এর বাকি অংশ Control করে।

02. Body:
- প্রথম sentence- এর পর থেকে শেষ sentence এর আগ পর্যন্ত পুরো অংশটাকে parragraph এর body বলা যায়।
- এতে এমন সব বাক্যসমষ্টি থাকে যা paragraph এর মূল idea বা theme কে উপস্থাপিত করে।

03. Terminator:
- এটাকে paragraph এর সমাপ্তি, উপসংহার বলে। এটি দিয়ে Paragraph শেষ হয়।
- অর্থাৎ একটি সার্থক সমাপ্তিসূচক sentence কে বলা হয় Terminator.

Source: High School English Grammar and Composition by Wren and Martin.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৬) The inclusion of date and place is commonly required in which form of writing?
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The inclusion of date and place is mandatory in - Report.

• Report লেখার সময় তারিখ (Date) এবং স্থান (Place) উল্লেখ করা অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। কারণ রিপোর্ট একটি আনুষ্ঠানিক ও তথ্যভিত্তিক লিখনী যেখানে নির্দিষ্ট ঘটনার বিবরণ, বিশ্লেষণ এবং পর্যবেক্ষণ উপস্থাপন করা হয়। তারিখ ও স্থানের মাধ্যমে রিপোর্টটি কখন এবং কোথায় রচিত হয়েছে তা স্পষ্ট হয়।

• Report Writing: 
- The definition of report writing is creating an account or statement that describes in detail an event, situation, or occurrence, usually as the result of observation or inquiry.
- দুটি প্রধান report writing হচ্ছে: news report writing এবং academic report writing. 
- Report writing is different from other forms of writing because it only includes facts, not the opinion or judgment of the writer.
- Report শব্দের বাংলা অর্থ প্রতিবেদন বা কোন তথ্যের বা কোন ঘটনার বিবরণ।
- Report লেখার শুরুতে source বা উৎস, Headline বা শিরোনাম, date বা তারিখ এবং place বা স্থানের নাম উল্লেখ করা হয়।

Source:
i) Advanced Learner's Grammar and Composition by Chowdhury and Hossain. 
ii) English TWO, HSC Program, Bangladesh Open University.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৭) What is the meaning of the idiom "fight shy of"?
NTRCA-Head.option2: To avoid or keep away from something
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• The meaning of the idiom "fight shy of" is - To avoid or keep away from something.

• Fight shy of:
- English Meaning: To try to avoid something.
- Bangla Meaning: কোনোকিছু এড়িয়ে চলা।

• Example Sentence: Why do you fight shy of me?
- Bangla Meaning: তুমি আমাকে এড়িয়ে চলছো কেন?

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৮) The synonym of the word "Facilitate" is -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Facilitate (Verb):
-English Meaning: To make something possible or easier.
- Bangla Meaning: (কোনো বস্তু বা প্রক্রিয়া) সহজ করা; কোনো অসুবিধা বা কষ্ট লাঘব করা; সহজতর করা।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Impede - বাধা দেওয়া।

খ) Ease - সহজ করা।

গ) Hinder - প্রতিবন্ধকতা।

ঘ) Itinerary - ভ্রমণের পরিকল্পনা; গমনপথ।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The synonym of the word "Facilitate" is - Ease.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৪৯) The antonym of the word "Obscure" is -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Obscure (Adjective, Verb & Noun):
- English Meaning: Not well known or difficult to understand; not clear or easy to see.
- Bangla Meaning: অন্ধকারময়; গুপ্ত; অস্পষ্ট।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Lucid - স্বচ্ছ; সহজবোধ্য।

খ) Cryptic - গুপ্ত; দুর্বোধ্য।

গ) Recondite - দুর্বোধ্য; নিগূঢ়।

ঘ) Pacification - শান্তকরণ বা শান্ত হওয়া; শান্তি প্রতিষ্ঠা।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The antonym of the word "Obscure" is - Lucid.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

NTRCA-Head.question: ৫০) The synonym of the word "Sedentary" is -
NTRCA-Head.exp:
• Sedentary (Adjective):
- English Meaning: Involving little exercise or physical activity.
- Bangla Meaning: (কাজ) বসে বসে করতে হয় এমন; (ব্যক্তি) অধিকাংশ সময় উপবিষ্ট থাকে এমন; আসনাশ্রিত; আসনারূঢ়।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Quiescent - শান্ত; নিশ্চল; নিষ্ক্রিয়।

খ) Eagerness - আগ্রহ।

গ) Dynamic - গতিময়; প্রাণবন্ত; কর্মশক্তিপূর্ণ।

ঘ) Flash -  আলোর ঝলক, চমক।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The synonym of the word "Sedentary" is - Quiescent.

Source: Merriam & Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.
